messages:
Aisha | Sales: Quick handover for StellarCare (trial account). POc signed for 30 days, region: eu-west, healthcare customer (HIPAA). Main blockers: SAML SSO not set up, they require private VPC + KMS integration, and procurement needs a dedicated quote by next Wed. Trial ends in 18 days so this is a renewal-risk if we don't hit POC goals. Demo recording: https://rwd.inc/demos/stellarcare-2026. Looping in @Maya to take CS lead.

Maya | CS: Thanks @Aisha — taking this on. Can you drop org id, main contact, and any notes on expected load? Also any compliance docs they asked for?

Aisha | Sales: Org ID: SC-5643. Main contact: matt@stellarcare.com (CTO). Demo usage ~10k tokens/day baseline, but they expect spikes during integration testing. They've asked for SOC2 + HIPAA BA info and KMS key rotation details. Procurement wants a detailed quote for Dedicated capacity and a private deployment option.

Maya | CS: Got it. I'll build an enablement checklist: kickoff, SSO test, env provisioning, data classification signoff, success metrics. Creating a support ticket now and assigning owners.

handoff-bot: Ticket CH-4321 created: "StellarCare onboarding - SAML + VPC + KMS". Priority: P1 (POC at risk). Assignees: Diego, Ravi. Link: https://rwd.inc/tickets/CH-4321

Diego | Support: I can start SAML testing this afternoon. I'll need their IdP metadata and a test user. Do they want Just-In-Time provisioning or manual user mapping?

Ravi | Eng: For the private connector we'll need the model name and expected QPS. Rough estimate: 3-4 dev-days to build connector + 1 day infra. If they want a quantized runtime, schedule may shift. Also need allowed seq lengths.

Maya | CS: Model: open-orion-13b, expected peak QPS ~60, avg seq len ~256. Success metric for POC: 95% requests <150ms p50 single-turn. Tagging as renewal-risk until procurement settles.

Diego | Support: @Maya please forward IdP metadata from Matt. If SAML blocks us temporarily we can offer API-key based access as a stopgap.

Aisha | Sales: Forwarded the IdP metadata to Diego; Matt confirmed via email. Procurement is reviewing budget, I'll push for the quote deadline. Also LOI mentions BA to be discussed.

Maya | CS: Scheduling kickoff Thu 10am CET. Invite sent to Matt and their engineering lead. Onboarding doc: https://rwd.inc/onboarding/stellarcare. Owners: Maya (CS lead), Diego (Support - SSO), Ravi (Eng - connector), Aisha (Sales).

Ravi | Eng: Note — private VPC will require subnet peering and a dedicated NAT gateway on our side. We'll need their networking contact and CIDR ranges to proceed.

Maya | CS: I'll request network owner + CIDR ranges and add to CH-4321. Also adding weekly syncs during trial and a short retro post-POC to capture feedback. Will attach demo clips for engineering.

Diego | Support: Quick legal flag — if HIPAA BA is required we'll need legal looped in early. @Aisha can you confirm BA request in LOI?

Aisha | Sales: Confirmed they flagged BA. LOI in drive: https://drive.rwd/stellarcare/LOI.pdf. Looping legal now.

handoff-bot: CH-4321 updated: added network_owner requested, legal flagged for BA, status: In progress.

Maya | CS: Summary / next steps (also in CH-4321): 1) SAML test (Diego) 2) Customer provides VPC/CIDR + networking contact 3) Connector dev scope & estimate (Ravi) 4) Quote for Dedicated capacity (Aisha + Sales Ops) 5) Kickoff Thu 10am CET. I'll update the ticket at each milestone and run weekly enablement checkpoints. Tagging owners: @Diego @Ravi @Aisha

Diego | Support: Acknowledged. I'll post SAML test results and attach logs in the ticket after testing.

Ravi | Eng: Acknowledged — I'll draft a connector plan and ETA by EOD tomorrow. Please add model artifact link and tokenization profile to CH-4321 when possible.

Maya | CS: Thanks all — leaving this thread open for updates. I'll follow up after kickoff and after the first SAML test.
